items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] I played? I don’t remember that at all. ... [INTERVIEWEE] I don’t recall that.

ctx.x: Richard Tee, all these guys. Thanks for reminding me of that. Yeah, a lot of those guys are dead. Those CTI records. They’re gone.
Like you said about jazz, it’s a demanding profession. Here was a session – a date that really caught my eye was Got to Get It, Bobby Timmons
I played? I don’t remember that at all.
